    theme: united

```{r}

rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)

s1 = 2# size for points in PCA plot
legend_pt_size =4
plot_title_size = 25
axis_text_size = 25
axis_title_size=25
legend_text_size=25
plot_text = 10
spacing=1
chosen_margin = c(0.5,1,0.5,1)# margins:top,right,bottom,left
theme_clean <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
        legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
        legend.title=element_blank() , 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())

qual_col_pals = brewer.pal.info[brewer.pal.info$category == 'qual',]
col_vector = unlist(mapply(brewer.pal, qual_col_pals$maxcolors, rownames(qual_col_pals)))
umap_data2 = read.delim("metadata_6_5_2026.txt", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)

umap_data2$cohorts = umap_data2$cluster
umap_data2$cohorts = gsub("cohort", "",  umap_data2$cohorts)
table(umap_data2$cohorts, useNA = "always")

umap_data2$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_STAGE[which( umap_data2$AJCC_PATHOLOGIC_STAGE =="na")] = NA_character_
umap_data2$GRADE[which( umap_data2$GRADE =="na")] = NA_character_
umap_data2$SMOKING.STATUS.X[which( umap_data2$SMOKING.STATUS.X =="na")] = NA_character_
umap_data2$RACE[which( umap_data2$RACE =="na")] = NA_character_
umap_data2$GENDER[which( umap_data2$GENDER =="na")] = NA_character_

#pacmap
p1= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(DATASET)),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DATASET )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + #  +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

ggdf = umap_data2[ order(umap_data2$DISEASE), ]
p2= ggplot(ggdf,  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")) +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

p3= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

## pca 
pca1= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(DATASET)),  aes(PC1, PC2, color=DATASET )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + #  +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

ggdf = umap_data2[ order(umap_data2$DISEASE), ]
pca2= ggplot(ggdf, aes(PC1, PC2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")) +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

pca3= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(PC1, PC2, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

## tSNE
t1= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(DATASET)),  aes(tSNE_1, tSNE_2, color=DATASET )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + #  +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

ggdf = umap_data2[ order(umap_data2$DISEASE), ]
t2= ggplot(ggdf, aes(tSNE_1, tSNE_2, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")) +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

t3= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(tSNE_1, tSNE_2, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

## UMAP
u1= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(DATASET)),  aes(UMAP1_2d, UMAP2_2d, color=DATASET )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + #  +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))

ggdf = umap_data2[ order(umap_data2$DISEASE), ]
u2= ggplot(ggdf ,  aes(UMAP1_2d, UMAP2_2d, color=DISEASE )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c( "orange", "blue", "darkgreen", "red")) +
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=1))

u3= ggplot(umap_data2 %>% arrange(desc(cohorts )),  aes(UMAP1_2d, UMAP2_2d, color=cohorts )) +
    geom_point(size=s1) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(col_vector[1:3], col_vector[5:21])) + 
    theme_clean + guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2))


lst = list( p1 , p2, p3, 
            pca1, pca2, pca3, 
            t1, t2, t3, 
            u1, u2, u3)
lst2 = lapply(lst, function(x) x + theme(legend.position = "none"))

pdf(file.path( "../Figures/Multiplot_supp_fig1_all_DR_METHODS_6_5_2026.pdf"),height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist = lst2, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

```
